issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְהָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת' refers to the Ashtaroth (Ashtoreth idols/goddesses), but the Chinese renders it as '阿實突女神廟' (temple of the goddess of Ashdod), which introduces a place name (Ashdod) not present in the Hebrew and changes the meaning from the idols/Ashtaroth to a specific temple.
